Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 3
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly shifted the likely answer from J. Robert Oppenheimer to Norris Bradbury, misidentifying who directed the Los Alamos project that developed the first atomic bomb. Oppenheimer (a physicist) directed the Los Alamos Laboratory during the Manhattan Project; Bradbury succeeded him after the war and did not direct the development of the first bomb.
